blind.description: A long stylized wooden bench featuring a flat top made of twin longitudinal planks with end caps, supported by three sculpted trestle leg assemblies with darker wooden foot blocks, joined underneath by a horizontal wooden stretcher beam.
blind.from_above: A long narrow brown rectangle with a lengthwise central seam, end framing, and the tips of six darker feet protruding slightly along the sides underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.8 to 2 ft high), and about twice to 2.5 times as long as the figure is tall (around 12 to 14 ft long).

match.reads_as: wooden bench / long narrow wooden table
notes: Read initially as a bench due to proportions, but functions well as a long trestle table at table distance
